# Community garden plan

Made-up project notes for tests. No real people or places.

## Budget

The seed budget is 4,500 rupees for the first season. Tomatoes and spinach take most of it.

## Watering

Drip irrigation runs every morning at 6. The rain barrel holds 200 litres.

## Contacts

The volunteer coordinator is Asha Example. Meetings are on the first Sunday of the month.
